content.text: If you're a digital creator in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, accepting Bitcoin for ebook sales can seem daunting. Countries like Nigeria and Venezuela face unique financial challenges, leaving creators without reliable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-what-actually-how-2|payment]] gateways. Fortunately, with the right infrastructure, you can establish a seamless system to accept Bitcoin and keep more of your profits. This guide will walk you through the steps to deploy a solution that avoids the high fees of conventional platforms and gives you full control over your sales process.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional platforms like Gumroad charge steep fees—up to 10% on each sale. For instance, if you're [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-trap-most-creators-walk-4|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-explained-digital-creators-9|Selling Music]] a $97 ebook and make 100 sales a month, that’s $921 retained with NOWPayments at just 0.5% fees. This infrastructure allows you to maintain control and maximize your revenue. By leveraging decentralized systems, you eliminate reliance on payment processors that may not serve your needs, ensuring that you can accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, while benefiting from low transaction fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your payment infrastructure, ensure you have a few essential components. First, sign up for NOWPayments to facilitate Bitcoin transactions with minimal fees. Next, choose a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, for your ebook store. You will also need a backend service for order management, which can be done through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Finally, make sure you have your ebook files ready for delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these components in place, you can build a robust digital sales platform.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin. Once set up, integrate their API into your website using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate payment verification. After a successful transaction, your backend should trigger an automatic delivery of the ebook files stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup ensures that customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation, creating a smooth transaction experience. Make sure to test this process thoroughly to ensure it operates flawlessly before going live.
Eliminate the 10% fees of platforms like Gumroad and save significantly with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything set up, it's time to go live. Share your ebook store URL with your audience and start promoting your products. Monitor your transactions closely during the first few days to ensure that payments are processing correctly and deliveries are happening as expected. You can utilize analytics tools to track sales performance and customer interactions. Encourage feedback from your initial customers to improve the purchasing experience. This early stage is crucial for identifying any adjustments needed in your infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your system is running smoothly, consider scaling your operations. Evaluate your current workload and plan for increased traffic as you promote your ebooks more aggressively. You can expand your product offerings by adding more digital downloads like courses, templates, and software. Leverage the Sovereign Blueprint for guidance on optimizing and scaling your infrastructure. This resource provides complete documentation and strategies for handling more transactions without compromising speed or efficiency.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider setting up a direct payment infrastructure using NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions. This method allows you to avoid platform fees and retain more of your revenue while ensuring immediate delivery of your digital products. You gain complete control over your sales process and eliminate reliance on conventional payment processors.
Your infrastructure means you retain full control over your sales and customer data.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides comprehensive documentation on setting up your infrastructure. Access it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for a complete guide to deploying your payment solutions and maximizing profits.
Your Deployment Checklist

Sign up for NOWPayments to enable Bitcoin transactions. Choose GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your ebook store. Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Test the payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly before going live. Promote your ebook store and monitor transactions closely. Scale your offerings as your sales grow.

Use NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin directly on your website. Integrate their API with your GitHub or Cloudflare-hosted store and automate delivery with Google Apps Script.

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low 0.5% fee. It offers quick payment confirmation and requires no buyer accounts, enhancing customer experience.
Is it difficult to set up my own payment processing?
Not at all. With tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, setting up your own payment processing is straightforward. Follow the deployment guide to get started quickly.
